attributes.board_name: Tennessee Board of Social Worker Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: In-person seminars/workshops (cross-disciplinary allowed), employer in-service training, events of professional associations or for which an accredited college grants CEUs; graduate (or for LBSW, undergraduate) social-work-related academic courses (max 15 hours, 1 credit = 15 hours); first-time presentation/teaching (max 75% incl. preparation); first-time professional paper (max 5); multi-media/distance courses with learning objectives and completion verification (max two-thirds of hours). The Board does not pre-approve programs.
rules.audit_note: Random audits, possibly in consecutive periods; evidence due within 15 working days. Keep proof 4 years from the end of the calendar year it was earned.

topics.who: T.C.A. §63-23-101 et seq. and the Board's rules
All LBSW/LMSW/LAPSW/LCSW: Board-approved training at least once every four years (Tullis Suicide Prevention Training Act); counts toward the hours

rules.notes: Biennial renewal by the last day of the birth month; CE is earned in the two calendar years before the renewal year. Each license category held must meet its own hours. New LBSW/LMSW licensees who apply in the exam year may count the exam for half the hours at the first renewal.
